invariants.description: the regulation function (exact): f = 1/(1 + u^n), u = max(0, 1 - x)/(1 - x_half), x = C/C_rest for ATP, G6P and glucose, x = H_rest/H_i for H+
invariants.expr: np.allclose(f_ATP_reg, 1/(1 + (np.maximum(0, 1 - np.maximum(cyto__C_ATP, 0)/C_ATP_rest)/(1 - K_ATP_reg/C_ATP_rest))**n_reg), rtol=1e-12, atol=1e-15) and np.allclose(f_G6P_reg, 1/(1 + (np.maximum(0, 1 - np.maximum(cyto__C_G6P, 0)/C_G6P_rest)/(1 - K_G6P_reg/C_G6P_rest))**n_reg), rtol=1e-12, atol=1e-15) and np.allclose(f_glc_reg, 1/(1 + (np.maximum(0, 1 - np.maximum(cyto__C_glc, 0)/C_glc_rest)/(1 - K_glc_reg/C_glc_rest))**n_reg), rtol=1e-12, atol=1e-15) and np.allclose(f_H_reg, 1/(1 + (np.maximum(0, 1 - H_rest/H__H_i)/(1 - H_rest/K_H_reg))**n_reg), rtol=1e-12, atol=1e-15)

invariants.description: f stays within 0-1, and is exactly 1 at and above rest (for H+ at and below the resting H+)
invariants.expr: np.all((f_ATP_reg >= 0) & (f_ATP_reg <= 1)) and np.all((f_G6P_reg >= 0) & (f_G6P_reg <= 1)) and np.all((f_glc_reg >= 0) & (f_glc_reg <= 1)) and np.all((f_H_reg >= 0) & (f_H_reg <= 1)) and np.all(f_ATP_reg[x_ATP_reg >= 1] == 1.0) and np.all(f_G6P_reg[x_G6P_reg >= 1] == 1.0) and np.all(f_glc_reg[x_glc_reg >= 1] == 1.0) and np.all(f_H_reg[x_H_reg >= 1] == 1.0)

invariants.description: the pool switched to ATP regulation (target 1) goes to f_ATP (exact), and while the cytosol's ATP runs down, f_ATP and the target fall with it
invariants.expr: np.allclose(pool_a__R_reg, f_ATP_reg, rtol=1e-12, atol=0) and np.allclose(pool_a__m_goal, f_ATP_reg, rtol=1e-12, atol=0) and np.all(np.diff(f_ATP_reg)*np.diff(cyto__C_ATP) >= -1e-15)

bc_sweep.rationale: steepness from graded (n = 2, still smooth at rest) to switch-like; half-way points from a tenth of the resting ATP to 83% of it, and for H+ from 0.08 to 0.6 pH units below rest (at rest itself u is undefined)
